posts.text:
All signs are pointing in the direction that Trump will follow through on his threat to "take" Cuba, as the country has run out of fuel, and the humanitarian crisis grows worse.

In Congress, we must urgently pass my legislation to stop Trump from using federal funding for military action in Cuba.

Video

This week, I spoke at @MPAC_National and @CSID_DC’s 24th Annual Conference about the need to protect democracy at home and abroad.

As Republicans in Congress continue to attack our Muslim neighbors, this conversation could not have come at a more important time.

There have been 10,000 rulings against Trump’s mass deportation agenda.

ICE is not above the law — and the courts have reaffirmed that in nearly 90% of cases.

Republicans want to force local and state law enforcement to comply with federal mass deportation policies by threatening to cut off billions in funding.

This will NOT work and is a dangerous threat.

Video

As the Pentagon continues an illegal war that has killed thousands of civilians and wasted billions of taxpayer dollars, I will absolutely NOT be voting for any new funding package.

We must continue to introduce War Power Resolutions until we can stop this war.

Video
You can read more about this tragic story here: washingtonpost.com/immigrati…

A devastating story has come out about a US citizen child, Orlin, who was murdered after ICE deported his mom.

This tragedy is an abject failure by ICE, and it’s why I will not give them another cent.

We must stop the cruelty and lawlessness of this administration.

Video

Marco Rubio is going to say whatever pleases Donald Trump.

But the American people heard it for themselves: Trump does not care about your financial situation.

Video

As a member of Congress, I have a duty to meet with people about the impact of US foreign policies.

No amount of right-wing attacks will deter me from working to end the US blockade and humanitarian crisis in Cuba. We need real negotiations between our countries.

Video

The $1 billion ballroom is rightfully getting a lot of attention.

But the same bill also gives $70 BILLION to Trump’s lawless ICE & CBP, which still have $103 BILLION left over from the Big Bad Betrayal Bill.

This bill wastes taxpayer dollars AND enables ICE's brutality.

Trump’s DOJ is targeting journalists for reporting on the Iran war.

This is an attack on the free press and on our First Amendment. As the Trump administration continues to lie to justify their illegal war — we need the press now more than ever. 
wsj.com/politics/national-se…

I recently had a great conversation on UNDISTRACTED with Brittany Packnett Cunningham, where we talked about everything from the Epstein Files to the Supreme Court’s attack on voting rights.

Check it out: 
piped.video/watch?v=ONF9PmaR…

Cuba has run out of diesel and fuel oil and is enduring some of the worst blackouts in decades because of the US’s cruel oil blockade.

This failed policy needs to end immediately. Every day, we are contributing to immense suffering in Cuba and a worsening humanitarian crisis. 
theguardian.com/world/2026/m…

JUST NOW: Republicans have once again voted to allow Trump’s senseless war with Iran to continue.

Billions of taxpayer dollars wasted. Thousands of lives lost. Soaring energy prices.

That’s what Republicans just voted for.

Immigrants who are afraid that local law enforcement will turn them over to ICE are less likely to report crimes or serve as witnesses.

This is why local policies that distinguish federal civil immigration law from local criminal law enforcement are important and keep us all safe.

Video

Republicans are using their anti-immigrant agenda to distract from the real issues at hand.

Video

Republicans held a hearing to attack communities that want everyone to feel safe calling 911 and reporting crimes.

Let's set the record straight: It's this administration's mass deportation campaign and lawless ICE that make us less safe.

Video
